questionText: if two units with backline attack a battlefield what happens with damage assignment
question: How does [Backline] affect combat damage assignment?
assumptions: RiftJudge p0035 — abstract '[Backline] units attacking' question. The bridge auto-builds a minimal [Backline] showdown: [Backline] units are assigned combat damage last (rule 460.2.c.2 / 826) — non-[Backline] units must receive lethal first.
